dev_eligible: Only the 270 added_training_paths in selection.json; never retained old training or eval.
dev_order: Ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 round9-v21-dev-v1:<decimal seed>, then path; whole seed groups.
pilot_eligible: Only added_training_paths remaining in train after dev removal.
pilot_order: For each family include the longest remaining input by operation count (path breaks ties), then fill the quota by SHA256 of round9-v21-pilot-v1:<decimal seed>, then path.
pilot_reason: Include a long flow from every family without looking at solver outcomes; avoid the earlier <=100k-operation selection bias. This pilot is not the official evaluation distribution.
eval_policy: All 72 eval cases sealed for one future frozen nomination wave; 36 retained exposed cases plus 36 new cases, not a fully blind test.
old_training_exposure: The retained 270 training cases may have participated in earlier train/dev experiments. They remain development data; only newly added training seeds can enter the new reserved dev.
online_feature_boundary: Split, seed, family, file names, generator specifications, future N/B, true probabilities and hidden penalty are offline-only. Scheduler inputs remain the original legal callbacks and SystemState.
